decision: Backend/worker lát M6 đã kiểm bằng SQLite và process controls; M6 vẫn mở. Chưa nối commit-before-native-result, lựa chọn nhân vật vào room hoặc native relogin sau persistence.

implementation.transaction: begin_match snapshots account/player/slot/character/team/map/time before playable publication. finish_match atomically records all outcomes/exits/reason/time and zero reward; duplicate normalized snapshot exact equals, conflicting content rejects.
implementation.startup: begin_instance atomically advances epoch/revokes sessions/cancels unfinished matches as server_restart+cancelled+unknown exit. Does not invent wins for unfinished rounds.
implementation.preference: Session-owned player preference, revision CAS and exact transition retry. Schema does not grant character entitlement/stats; serving choices must authorize supported keys.
implementation.worker: PersistenceJob on bounded normal worker; execution-UTC, queue expiry/cancellation/Busy, dropped committed reply recovered by same key. Live-auth lane refuses persistence jobs. Channel preference API uses owned player/token plus post-await DB/frontend-generation check, normal persistence lane separated from live auth.
implementation.cli: match-history-account and match-history-room are trusted local read APIs; no manual grant or match-result mutation endpoint.

checks.process_controls: Two actual SIGKILL controls after start-only commit and after outcome commit, retained DB/readback/control.json. Complete outcome survives; incomplete match cancels once at restart.

retained_failures.result: Old migration test hardcoded target version2; schema3 returned3. Updated to SCHEMA_VERSION, preserving explicit future/old2 corruption tests; mutex poison follow-ons are same failed test process, not independent backend defects.
Test helper private Temp path visibility compilation failure; corrected test-only visibility, no runtime behavior change.

Revocation test used stale UTC captured before worker advanced durable clock. Store correctly returned ClockRollback; changed test admin timestamp to execution UTC. Isolated worker retry/revoke test passed.
Precondition refused source with SQLite sidecar present; no copy/mutation.
Same refusal for source with zero-byte read-only-created WAL. Use exact already frozen quiescent source copy for R3; no WAL pair guessed/copied or old raw modified.

limits: All new evidence is design/method=test, real SQLite/KDF/worker/sockets/process controls. No new native KR result/persistence/preference claim.
Caller must retain the same stable start/outcome event key/time/snapshot across retries. Storage idempotency does not itself prove serving has committed before a wire result.
Preference numbers are internal product data, not entitlement/stats/wire support. Current KR round catalog supports0/1 only; other keys must remain rejected by serving.
No balances,EXP,levels,inventory,shop or nonzero reward. Schema only zero reward records; broad economy remains outside phase1.
Schema3 requires new binary. No automatic downgrade/destructive rollback; operational backup/restore/upgrade rollback remains M8.
Restart backend cancels running rows; actual room/start/outcome/disconnect/shutdown integration and native relogin acceptance remain next work.

reuse.direct: Existing Store transactions/schema validation/clock/session fences/KDF, bounded Worker and real SQLite test infrastructure. Preserve existing native authority/result policy; backend decisions are company design.
reuse.old: CP213 architecture/source reuse and existing KR runtime rank/reset contracts retained; no new legacy repo code, VN opcodes/authority, client modifications or broad RE.
reuse.avoids: Backend/DB work proceeds independently of map/item RE. No new wire inferred or fake ACK introduced.
